title: How Do Street Lights Know It's Night? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Ever wonder how street lights flip on the second it gets dark, with no one flipping a switch?
💡 A tiny light-sensitive resistor called an LDR hides inside every street lamp
🔬 Its zigzag cadmium sulfide track reacts to light itself
⚡ Bright light frees electrons, dropping resistance so current flows
🌙 Darkness spikes resistance, tripping a tiny circuit that turns the lamp on
Subscribe for more quick explainers on the tech hiding in plain sight!
